subject.title: Feature request: config option to suppress sub-agent announce

question: Should deterministic suppression be a per-spawn-only control, or also a persistent `agents.defaults.subagents` policy, and what single vocabulary should subsume the overlapping routing requests?
rationale: Current main proves the runtime need and already carries internal completion state, but repository policy sets a high bar for new configuration and the related issues propose competing boolean, policy, channel, and target semantics that code review cannot safely choose.

options.title: One typed policy
options.body: Add a shared enum used by `sessions_spawn` and optionally `agents.defaults.subagents`, preserving current behavior by default and including an explicit skip outcome.

options.title: Per-spawn only
options.body: Expose a narrow `sessions_spawn` suppression parameter and defer persistent or per-channel defaults to avoid expanding configuration now.

options.title: Keep token control
options.body: Treat parent-review routing plus `ANNOUNCE_SKIP` and `NO_REPLY` as sufficient and close the suppression requests without a framework control.

recommendation.title: One typed policy
recommendation.body: Add a shared enum used by `sessions_spawn` and optionally `agents.defaults.subagents`, preserving current behavior by default and including an explicit skip outcome.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans the spawn schema, completion behavior, delivery hardening, and documentation needed for this product/API choice.
